name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code by Barış Demirhan: ambient scenes, a deck for the work behind the conversation, a T-Rex runner, a pomodoro timer and an idle game

plugins.name: ambient
plugins.description: A living band above the prompt that Claude's work feeds, with sound: an aquarium, a bonsai, a skyline, constellations, weather that can follow the real sky, a train, Game of Life, a heartbeat, a fireplace, digital rain or a lofi desk. /ambient picks the scene

plugins.name: deck
plugins.description: A pane beside the conversation for the work behind it: running shells and agents, the model and a clickable effort meter, and step-by-step progress of any job as a tree: /deck

plugins.name: dino
plugins.description: A T-Rex runner in a pane, inspired by Chrome's offline game: /dino, then space to jump, s to duck and p to pause while Claude works

plugins.name: pomodoro
plugins.description: A pomodoro timer on the prompt's hint line whose break lands while Claude works, with buttons beside it, a history and a report: /pomodoro start

plugins.name: tycoon
plugins.description: Token Tycoon, an idle game in a pane: Claude's tool calls earn tokens, tokens buy generators and upgrades, and everything is kept between sessions. /tycoon opens it
